title: Team AI Training · Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day, hands-on AI training workshop delivered on your team's own tools and documents. $1,000 per person, 5-person minimum, travel included. Creosote Labs.
sub: A one-day, hands-on workshop delivered on your team's own tools, documents, and templates. Designed for teams of 5 to 20 people who work primarily in email, documents, and spreadsheets.
format: Delivered in person at your office, or remotely for smaller groups.
Runs in the AI tool your company already uses: Microsoft 365 Copilot, Google Gemini, or Claude.
Participants work on their own computers with their own documents and templates.
One department per session. Managers attend with their teams.
Up to 20 participants per session. Larger teams are scheduled as consecutive sessions.
included: A planning call and a one-page IT checklist before the session.
A written guide for the team, covering everything built during the day.

agenda.text: Setup. Confirming accounts, tools, and sample documents on each participant's computer.
Introduction. What the tool does and does not do, and your company's rules for what data it can be used with.
Workflow 1. Each participant produces a document they create regularly, from their own template.
Workflow 2. A recurring task involving data: cleaning up a spreadsheet, summarizing a report, drafting a set of replies.
Working instructions. Each participant documents their own process so the tool can follow it consistently.
Workflow 3, or a session for managers on where the tools fit in the team's week.
Review of the written guide. Agreement on a 30-day measure. Scheduling of the follow-up session.

requirements: Company accounts and licenses for the chosen AI tool for each participant. Licenses are not included in the price; the IT checklist lists the plan each tool requires.
Three sample documents per participant, placed in a folder on your company's own storage before the session.
A meeting room with a computer for each participant, and lunch.
security: All work is done on your computers, in your company's accounts. Creosote Labs keeps no copies of your documents.
Data is sent only to the AI tool vendor your company has already approved.
Nothing is installed on staff computers unless your IT department chooses a desktop version of the tool.
A non-disclosure agreement is available on request.

pricing.name: Training day
pricing.text: Up to 10 people at this rate; 5-person minimum. Teams of 11 or more receive a single quote before booking. Travel is included for groups of 10 or more anywhere in the United States; smaller groups are delivered remotely at the same price, or in person by arrangement.

pricing.name: Training program
pricing.text: The training day plus three monthly half-day follow-up sessions on your team's own work. Same minimum and group pricing as the training day.

faqs.q: Do participants need prior experience with AI tools?
faqs.a: No. The session starts from setup and is built around each participant's own work.
Headcount is set at booking. The written guide covers everything built during the day, and anyone who misses the session can attend the 30-day follow-up.

faqs.q: How is the day's result measured?
faqs.a: Before the session, we agree on one measure with you, such as documents produced per week or time spent on a specific task, and review it at the 30-day follow-up.

book_text: A 20-minute conversation about your team, the tools you use, and available dates. No obligation.
